segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I had us down for 20 minutes to walk through the renewal and the added seats for the support team. Does that still work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We’re trying to get this wrapped up before August 15, because that’s when our current term ends.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. So the renewal would keep the same plan, same support package, and move you from 42 seats to 55 seats. The new annual total comes to $48,950 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I saw in the quote. Can you confirm the additional 13 seats are available on September 1? We don’t need them before then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can set the expansion effective September 1. The base renewal starts August 16, and the added seats start September 1, so the invoice will show those as separate line items.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team asked for net 30 terms again. Nothing changed there, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, net 30 stays in place. Billing will send the invoice to ap@northlakeparts.com, and I have Casey Miller listed as the billing contact.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s correct. One more thing, the contract says auto-renewal with 60 days’ notice. Legal is fine with that as long as the term is 12 months, not 24.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, this is a 12-month term, August 16, 2026 through August 15, 2027. I’ll send the order form after this call, and once it’s signed we’ll schedule the September 1 seat activation.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it over today if you can, and I’ll route it for signature.
